items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: we had gone through the Bessie Smiths, the Ma Rainey, the what-have-yous

ctx.x: And the second track was How Long Blues was by Leroy Carr. Now what you want to say about that?

Leroy Carr was the kind of a blues singer that according to our social standards at the time, from the years of '27 up to 1930, we had gone through the Bessie Smiths, the Ma Rainey, the what-have-yous, but Leroy Carr...
